title: Edge asymptotics for weighted Robin equations on cylinders with applications to spectral fractional Laplacians
summary: For a class of weighted degenerate or singular problems on a cylinder, Almgren-type monotonicity methods are employed to derive asymptotic estimates of solutions near the edge between the base and the lateral surface, where a Robin boundary condition is imposed. As a relevant application, local asymptotics and unique continuation from the boundary are obtained for the Robin and Neumann spectral fractional Laplacians.
